name: AP_INV_APRVL_HIST_ALL
description: AP_INV_APRVL_HIST_ALL contains the approval and rejection history of each invoice that passes through the Invoice Approval Workflow process.  The process inserts a record for each approver assigned to review an invoice.  This table corresponds to the Invoice Approval History window.

columns.name: APPROVAL_HISTORY_ID
columns.description: Identifier for every record created under approval cycle.

columns.name: INVOICE_ID
columns.description: Unique identifier for invoice that is undergoing the approval cycle.

columns.name: ITERATION
columns.description: Count of times invoice has passed through the Invoice Approval Workflow process

columns.name: RESPONSE
columns.description: Response of the approver on a given invoice.

columns.name: APPROVER_ID
columns.description: Login user name of approver for given invoice.

columns.name: AMOUNT_APPROVED
columns.description: Invoice amount at time of approver response

columns.name: APPROVER_COMMENTS
columns.description: Comments provided by the approver on a given invoice.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: ORG_ID
columns.description: Indicates the identifier of the business unit associated to the row.

columns.name: NOTIFICATION_ORDER
columns.description: Order that the notifications were sent to approvers

columns.name: ORIG_SYSTEM
columns.description: Originating system for the approver_id

columns.name: ITEM_CLASS
columns.description: The AME Item Class that required this approval

columns.name: ITEM_ID
columns.description: Unique identifier used by the AME transaction type to identify an item in an Item Class.  The AME item Id for the Item Class that required this approval.

columns.name: LINE_NUMBER
columns.description: Invoice line number

columns.name: HOLD_ID
columns.description: Identifier used to identify the hold applied on an invoice.

columns.name: HISTORY_TYPE
columns.description: Approval type required on a invoice.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

columns.name: INTERFACE_INVOICE_ID
columns.description: Invoice unique identifier from the AP_INVOICES_INTERFACE table.

columns.name: LOAD_REQUEST_ID
columns.description: Enterprise Service Scheduler: indicates the Import Payables Invoices process ID created the row.

columns.name: APPROVAL_REQUEST_ID
columns.description: Enterprise Service Scheduler: indicates the request ID of Initiate invoice approval job that created or last updated the row.

columns.name: HISTORY_HASHCODE
columns.description: Stores the hash code keys for comments, attachments, or history records. Hash code keys are 20 characters long. The application can store a maximum of 11 hash codes separated by comma. As a result, the length limit for the column is 229 characters, including commas.

columns.name: RULE_NAME
columns.description: The workflow rule used for assigning the workflow task to the user.

columns.name: APPROVAL_STEP
columns.description: The approval step where the workflow rule is defined.

columns.name: ACTION_DATE
columns.description: The date when an assignee performed an action on a particular workflow task.
